Despite the attack, Kalaikunda airbase remained operational throughout the remainder of the war.

title: Federer, Sampras, Kuerten... no one: After 149 years, end of an era in tennis

Once dominant, the one-hander has given way to the more practical two-handed backhand. Modern coaching trends and the evolving speed of the game have contributed to its fading presence among top players.

title: What does the law say about inheritance? Know your rights
content: inheritance in india has been shaped by family relationships, religious personal laws and the nature of the property being inherited . a daughter may have an equal right with her brother in one situation, but not necessarily in another . the biggest question often arises when a person dies without leaving a will .
